bug: cmd 66 (direct_torque, PolyScope >= 5.26 branch) reads the requested scales into viscous_scale / couloumb_scale but calls direct_torque(torque, viscous_scale=viscous_scaling, coulomb_scale=coulomb_scaling), whose variables stay at the zero initialization. Requested friction compensation is silently disabled. ur_rtde 1.6.4 passed the read scales positionally (correct).
fix: Read the registers into viscous_scaling / coulomb_scaling (two lines). Wrapped in def rtde_control(): ... end, as ScriptClient::sendScript does for the compiled-in script; version-marker filtering and register-offset injection are applied by ur_rtde to custom files the same way.
use: collect_thunder.collect() uploads it with RTDEControlInterface.setCustomScriptFile only when nonzero direct_torque_params are requested; zero-compensation runs keep the stock compiled-in script.
